messages:
sam_support: FYI escalating Mosaic Labs — embed ingestion failures after prod key rotation, customer is blocked on deployment and mentioned renewal concern today.
elaine_cs: got it. what's the error they're seeing? any ETA from infra?
matt_eng: logs show 403s on /v1/embeddings with token mismatch. sample:
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"invalid_api_key","message":"key expired"}
```
sam_support: they rotated keys on their side, but our provisioning path didn't pick up the new client id. Happened 10:14 PST. Contact: alex@mosaic.ai, CSM noted renewal touchpoint next week.
elaine_cs: ack. priority = P1 for CS — this directly impacts go-live and renewal. Need a comms plan before EOD.
jen_sales: pinging me in case we need a hold on the renewal reminder. don't want automated renewal notices to trigger while blocked.
matt_eng: short-term fix: re-provision Mosaic's tenant with their new client id. I can do a scoped rollback if needed. ETA 40m if ops gives greenlight.
sam_support: ops-bot: request infra re-provision for tenant mosaic-tenant-43 with client_id=xxxx-REDACTED
ops-bot: @matt_eng request received; queued for manual review. ticket #INF-4821
elaine_cs: comms plan draft: 1) immediate heads-up to Alex + C-suite with apology and ETA. 2) daily status updates until resolved. 3) offer 2 weeks free usage + priority onboarding session as a goodwill credit if resolution > 4h. Approve?
jen_sales: approve the goodwill credit, align legal for billing note. I'll email Alex once we have confirmed ETA.
matt_eng: starting re-provision now. I'll post progress here. tagging @sam_support for verification tests.
sam_support: once re-provisioned, I'll run embedding sanity tests and confirm model responses.
elaine_cs: assign owners: ENG = matt_eng, SUPPORT = sam_support, CS = elaine_cs, SALES = jen_sales. I'll send the external comms (short + transparent).
jen_sales: suggested external wording: "We're aware of an issue affecting embedding ingestion after a recent key change. Our engineering team is working on a fix; we'll update hourly until resolved. We're sorry for the disruption." OK?
elaine_cs: yes, concise and no blame. I'll send at 11:20 PST when we confirm a 40m ETA.
matt_eng: re-provision complete — testing now. no more 403s in test batch.
sam_support: tests pass on our side. Alex confirmed examples loading in staging.
elaine_cs: sending comms now. I'll include the goodwill credit + next steps. Jen, can you coordinate billing note after I send?
jen_sales: on it. I'll draft the billing adjustment and loop legal.
elaine_cs: thanks team. tagging @ops-bot to close INF-4821 when billing note is attached.
ops-bot: INF-4821 updated: resolution deployed and confirmed; awaiting billing note. Closing ETA: 24h.
sam_support: closing thread for now — will reopen if Alex reports any regression. :thumbsup:
